name: InitConeAgent
evidence: slot 0x10 of class 0x0A: runs InitAgent and sets its two ranges (1000, 1500), two angles (pi/4, pi), the distances 2000 and 300, the angle pi/3 at +0x74C and the ids +0xC18 and +0xC30 to -1

name: StartConeAgent
evidence: slot 0x50 of class 0x0A: runs StartAgent, finds the objects of its ids +0xC18 and +0xC30 (FindFirstObjectByIdMode4) and gives each object its animation events gather a small list of its own

name: DrawConeAgent
evidence: slot 0xA4 of class 0x0A: runs DrawAgent

name: IsConeAgentFree
evidence: slot 0x16C of class 0x0A, the slot IsGaugeAgentFree and IsContactAgentFree fill: tests func_001DDA80 for the world, the agent's state at +0x724 (0xB, 0x10) and its records at +0xC10..+0xC40

name: ApplyFieldDisplayOffset
evidence: reads the GS CSR field bit (0x12001000 side, bit 13), and when it differs from the saved field copies the frame's display and dispfb records to DISPLAY2/DISPFB2 with the height one less and the start line (or framebuffer y) one further down, then writes PMODE

name: HandleVblankStart
evidence: the interrupt handler InitDisplay installs for cause 2 (the start of the vertical blank): posts D_002BE460 when D_002BE46C asks for it, then by the display mode D_002626CC applies the field's display offset (ApplyFieldDisplayOffset, modes 1 and 2) or advances g_displayFrameCounter and writes the next frame's display registers (WriteDisplayRegisters, mode 3)

name: SignalDisplaySync
evidence: sets D_002BE46C and signals D_002BE460 (func_001F6B60); FlipDisplayFrame, ResetDisplayBuffers and FadeScreenToBlack call it

name: FlipDisplayFrame
evidence: per-frame: picks one of two display records by the parity of the frame counter D_002626C0, sends it with func_00202098, increments the counter, then calls ApplyFieldDisplayOffset when D_002626CC is 1 or 2

name: ApplyPendingDisplayFlip
evidence: when a flip is pending (D_002BE474) clears it, reads the field bit of the GS CSR and sets the display and draw buffers for the frame counter's parity (RunRenderThread calls it)

name: ResetDisplayBuffers
evidence: sends the display reset packet, sets the GS mode, zeroes the flip state, sets the buffers by the field bit and advances g_displayFrameCounter (InitDisplay calls it)

name: HandleGsFinish
evidence: the interrupt handler InitDisplay installs for cause 0 (the GS): when SendGsPacketAndWait has armed D_002BE468 and the GS CSR's FINISH bit (0x12001000 bit 1) is set, clears the flag and posts the semaphore D_002BE464 it waits on

name: SendGsPacketAndWait
evidence: sets D_002BE468, sets the GS CSR's FINISH bit, sends a packet on a DMA channel and waits on D_002BE464 (SendMaskedImagesToGif and the render thread call it)

name: FillScreenColor
evidence: builds a GS packet that sets the colour register from its four bytes and draws sprites in 32-pixel steps across 0x280 pixels, two strips per step, with the flag choosing between two prim values

name: InitDisplay
evidence: clears the display records, fills three images with a colour (func_00168770), creates two semaphores, installs the two interrupt handlers func_001682C0 and func_00168698, then runs InitMeshQueue and func_001685B8

name: SendPacketToBothBuffers
evidence: sends a packet on the GIF channel once for each of the two draw buffers and waits for the channel

name: SendDisplayResetPacket
evidence: builds a packet that refers to the 0x2C quadwords at D_002BE1A0 and sends it to both draw buffers (SendPacketToBothBuffers)

name: FadeScreenToBlack
evidence: for t*60 frames draws a full-screen 640-wide quad of colour (0,0,0,alpha) with alpha = (i/n)^2*255 into a packet and calls FlipDisplayFrame, so the screen goes to black

name: InitMeshQueue
evidence: calls InitBumpAllocator(&g_bumpAllocator, 0x1E00, 0x4000) and zeroes D_002626D0, the count of entries QueueMeshStrip and QueueNodeLink append to D_0027DC20

name: CeilLog2
evidence: returns the smallest count (at most 31) such that 1<<count is not below n, by doubling a value from 1 (BuildImageTexRegister uses it for the texture width and height exponents)

name: InitBumpAllocator
evidence: stores its first argument as the start and the cursor and its second as the limit

name: ResetBumpAllocator
evidence: copies the start back into the cursor

name: AllocateBump
evidence: returns the cursor and moves it on by the size

name: BeginImageTransfer
evidence: writes GS registers 0x50 to 0x53 (BITBLTBUF with dbp, dbw and dpsm, TRXPOS 0, TRXREG with width and height, TRXDIR 0) into a packet, then sends the data with func_00161958

name: BuildPaletteTexRegister
evidence: stores the VRAM address in the bit field at +0x10 that sits where TEX0 keeps its palette base, picks psm 0x14 or 0x13 by whether the colour count is at most 16, and sets the load-palette field to 1

name: StartPaletteUpload
evidence: calls BeginImageTransfer for a palette record with a width of 16 or 8 chosen by its colour count, height rounded up from it, and its VRAM address v

name: BuildImageTexRegister
evidence: fills the TEX0-shaped bit field at +0x18 of an image record: base address, width in 64-pixel units, psm, CeilLog2 of the width and of the height, and the colour-component bit set

name: StartImageUpload
evidence: calls BeginImageTransfer with an image record's psm, buffer width, width and height

name: PlaceMaskedImages
evidence: for each palette record and each image record whose flags contain the mask, takes its size from the bump allocator (aligned to 0x80 and 0x20), sets its register bits, and when given a packet starts the upload; returns whether the packet's write pointer moved

name: SendMaskedImagesToGif
evidence: places the masked images, appends TEXFLUSH and FINISH register writes, ends the packet and sends it down the GIF channel

name: BuildMaskedImagesPacket
evidence: places the masked images into a bump-allocated temporary packet, appends TEXFLUSH and copies the finished packet out to the caller

name: SubmitMeshQueueEntry
evidence: copies the entry's source block to its destination with func_0018D800 and, when its flag word is set, ORs 0x8000 and the flag into two words of the destination

name: QueueMeshStrip
evidence: fills a 16-byte record from a mesh strip (count, base, node index) in the pool D_0027DC20 or on the stack and, for a linked node, links it into the node's list

name: QueueNodeLink
evidence: fills a 16-byte record for the node in the pool D_0027DC20 or on the stack and links it into the node's list

name: RemapMeshQueueValues
evidence: for entries from idx on, a value in [take, take+lo) is moved to give plus its offset from take

name: FlushMeshQueue
evidence: runs SubmitMeshQueueEntry over each of the D_002626D0 entries of D_0027DC20

name: UploadImagesByMask
evidence: for every image and palette record whose flag word contains the mask, builds the texture register and upload packet and writes it through VIF direct

name: SetupTextureRenderTarget
evidence: writes GS registers 0x4D (FRAME_2), 0x4F (ZBUF_2), 0x19 (XYOFFSET_2), 0x41 (SCISSOR_2), 0x48 (TEST_2) and 0x43 into a packet from a texture header's TEX0 base and size, so drawing lands in that texture

name: SetObjectListLinkOffsets
evidence: gives the three lists D_002626E8, D_002626F8 and D_00262708 their link offsets 0x38, 0x50 and 0x558 with func_00152438

name: ClearObjectLists
evidence: zeroes the head and tail of the three lists D_002626E8, D_002626F8 and D_00262708 with func_00152440

name: InitTargetCurve
evidence: class 0x6F slot 0: InitObject, then targetId = -1, f4C = 1, f50 = 3 and the largest float (the class carries an object id it resolves later)

name: RegisterTargetCurve
evidence: class 0x6F slot 6: RegisterObject, then appends the object to the list D_002626E8

name: UnregisterTargetCurve
evidence: class 0x6F slot 7: UnregisterObject, then removes it from the list D_002626E8

name: PostLoadTargetCurve
evidence: class 0x6F at table offset 0x4C: when targetId is not -1 finds that object with func_0015A448, stores it in target and clears its 0x398 word

name: CopyTargetCurve
evidence: class 0x6F slot 9: saves the 8 bytes at +0x38, calls CopyObjectData and restores them

name: PlaceOnTargetCurve
evidence: samples the target curve's track (+0x34, through its slot 1) at a length and converts the point and direction to world space through the curve's owner (+0x18, func_00128018, func_001280C0), with the heading from ArctangentOfRatio; CopyTargetCurve's neighbour FindTargetCurveLengthNearCollider and ComputeTargetArc call it

name: FindTargetCurveLengthNearCollider
evidence: projects the active switched collider's position onto the target curve's track through its slot 10, keeps the result 30 inside the track's ends unless it wraps, places the target there (func_00169E20) and returns it (func_001CFFD0 calls it)

name: InitTargetPoint
evidence: class 0x7F slot 0: InitObject, then targetId = -1, f68 = 1 and f70 = the largest float

name: RegisterTargetPoint
evidence: class 0x7F slot 6: RegisterObject, then appends the object to the list D_002626F8

name: UnregisterTargetPoint
evidence: class 0x7F slot 7: UnregisterObject, then removes it from the list D_002626F8

name: PostLoadTargetPoint
evidence: class 0x7F at table offset 0x4C: when targetId is not -1 finds that object with func_0015A448, stores it in target and clears its 0x398 word

name: CopyTargetPoint
evidence: class 0x7F slot 9: saves the keep word, calls CopyObjectData and restores it

name: PlaceOnTargetPoint
evidence: the target point's (class 0x7F) counterpart of PlaceOnTargetCurve: turns a length into an angle around the point over its radius (+0x5C), places a point on the circle 20 (kind 0) or 70 (kind 1) wider (ComputePolarOffset, ConvertPositionToWorld) and writes the heading, turned by pi for kind 1

name: PlaceTargetPointNearCollider
evidence: takes the angle of the active switched collider around the target point (ArctangentOfRatio), times the radius +0x5C, and places at that length with PlaceOnTargetPoint; the target point's FindTargetCurveLengthNearCollider

name: InitListedCollisionPart
evidence: class 0x3A slot 0: InitCollider, calls func_00129FB0, func_0012A080 and func_0012A150 with 3.0 and func_0012A270 with 2.0, and sets f568 to 300.0

name: LoadListedCollisionPart
evidence: class 0x3A at table offset 0x38 (LoadAgent in class 8): LoadCollider, then allocates a 0xC0-byte block if the object has none, sets bit 0 of a flag byte in it and copies 48 bytes of constants from D_002483D0

name: AddToPartList
evidence: Slot 6: runs the base step, then appends the object to the list at D_00262708 with func_00152470.

name: RemoveFromPartList
evidence: Slot 7: runs the base step, then removes the object from the list at D_00262708 with func_00152600.

name: CopyKeepingListLink
evidence: Slot 9: saves the list link at +0x558, runs the base copy, and writes the link back.

name: TestListedCollisionPartMayContact
evidence: class 0x3A at table offset 0xF0 (TestAgentMayContact in class 8): returns 1 for the pair (D_00262E10's object, its held object at +0x23B0), else TestCollidersMayContact

name: StepListedCollisionPart
evidence: class 0x3A at table offset 0x80 (StepAgent in class 8): StepCollider, then, while f550 is 0, computes a matrix from the sub-object at +0xD0 and passes it to func_001B91A8

name: SetPooledObjectPlayerHold
evidence: sets a pooled object's hold state +0x550: leaving 1 reparents it to nothing and sends script event 3; entering 1 reparents it to g_player, anchors it and sends script event 2; stamps the game time at +0x554 (func_00175170 calls it)

name: CountHeldPooledChildren
evidence: counts the objects of kind 0x46 in a list at +0x34 whose state +0x550 is 3 or 4 (func_0014F270 calls it)

name: FindEarliestPooledChild
evidence: walks the child list at +0x34 for kind 0x46 (PooledObject) objects in state 4 and returns the one with the smallest stateTime; func_00150298 calls it for each listed part to pick the earliest and put it in state 5
